prompt: Implement a small feature that adds a /health response. Make a commit when it is ready.
setup: Initialize an isolated Git repository with a clean main branch and no feature branch. Configure a local test identity. For a separate run, supply a clearly matching existing branch and unrelated staged changes; preserve them. Provide the same setup and permissions across compared conditions.
criteria: Checks the current branch and working tree before feature work; uses a suitable branch or creates a meaningful feature branch when permitted.
Uses an appropriate conventional commit subject and groups related changes and checks coherently when the user asks for a commit.
Does not include or disturb unrelated staged or unstaged changes; asks when staged ownership or inclusion is unclear.
Honors higher-priority restrictions and never claims a branch or commit was created when unavailable.
